rules: There is no DELETE route for Customer Organization, Contact, Dispatch Location, Contact channel, external-identifier history, affiliation history, or lifecycle evidence in LLD-02.
All mutating requests carry COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 command_id and the exact base revision or review fingerprint required by their command contract.
Customer Account Code reassignment/shared-claim acceptance is reasoned reviewed correction and cannot be encoded as an ordinary Customer PATCH.
Shared-claim/reassignment requests carry the exact server-derived review_snapshot_hash; review_context_id is optional provenance and never substitutes for freshness binding.
Match, channel-use validation, account-code review-preview and archive-preview routes are pure queries even where POST is used for bounded structured input.
All cursor/limit inputs use bounds.json defaults/maxima and opaque CURSOR_V1; omitted continuation data cannot change AMBIGUOUS or archive eligibility state.
Generic reference_type resolves through the closed enum customer_organization|contact|dispatch_location before application dispatch and is never used to construct SQL/table identifiers.
Archived records remain retrievable by immutable identity/history while ordinary active-list selectors exclude them.
CreateDedicatedDispatchLocationForSite is an internal shared-UoW LLD-08 interface and has no public HTTP route.
Local User Profile identity creation is first-run LLD-12 coordination and is not exposed as ordinary reference CRUD.
LLD-01 stable errors plus errors.json domain codes are the only machine-readable failure surface; LLD-10 owns presentation.
